answer: Sybil resistance works when every identity must post a refundable bond that is slashed on detected collusion: one honest agent is cheap, a thousand fakes ruinous. Reaching the summit of voting power means hauling real timber, since each forged agent carries its own costly deposit, so a lone sparrow cannot fake a whole flock. If N identities each lock deposit D, seizing a majority costs N times D upfront and correlated behaviour burns it, so an attacker's loss scales linearly with the identities they fabricate.
